const {chromium}=require('playwright');
const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),assert=require('node:assert/strict');
const gameURL=process.env.QA_URL||'http://127.0.0.1:4186/?qa';
const out=path.join(__dirname,'palace-browser');fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});
const progressKey='mosslight-3d-progress',godKey='mosslight-3d-god';
const report={scope:'Staged feature and responsive checks. Normal gameplay proof is separately recorded by palace-browser-playthrough.cjs.',checks:[],layouts:[],errors:[]};
function ok(value,message){assert.ok(value,message);report.checks.push(message);console.log('PALACE_FEATURE '+message)}
async function ready(page){await page.goto(gameURL);await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.__qa&&document.querySelector('#loading').classList.contains('hidden'));}
async function contextPage(browser,storage={},options={}){const context=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1440,height:900},...options});await context.addInitScript(values=>{for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(values))localStorage.setItem(key,typeof value==='string'?value:JSON.stringify(value))},storage);const page=await context.newPage();page.on('pageerror',e=>report.errors.push(String(e)));page.on('console',m=>{if(m.type()==='error')report.errors.push(m.text())});await ready(page);return {context,page}}
async function godSynced(page,enabled){assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().godMode),enabled);const states=await page.locator('[data-god-toggle]').evaluateAll(es=>es.map(e=>e.getAttribute('aria-pressed')));assert.equal(states.length,3);assert.deepEqual(states,[String(enabled),String(enabled),String(enabled)]);}
async function stagedComplete(page,index){await page.evaluate(index=>{__qa.begin(index);const w=__qa.world(),a=w.platforms.at(-1);Object.assign(w.player,{x:a.x,z:a.z-1.5,y:a.y,vx:0,vy:0,vz:0,on:a.id,grounded:true});},index);await page.waitForFunction(()=>gameInfo().mode==='complete');}
async function fits(page,selector,label){const boxes=await page.locator(selector).evaluateAll(es=>es.filter(e=>e.getClientRects().length).map(e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(),top=document.elementFromPoint(r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2);return {id:e.id||e.dataset.level,x:r.x,y:r.y,right:r.right,bottom:r.bottom,w:r.width,h:r.height,hit:!!top&&(top===e||e.contains(top)),text:e.innerText}}));const {width,height}=page.viewportSize();assert.ok(boxes.length,label+' has controls');for(const b of boxes){assert.ok(b.x>=-1&&b.y>=-1&&b.right<=width+1&&b.bottom<=height+1,label+' clipped: '+JSON.stringify(b));assert.ok(b.hit,label+' obscured: '+JSON.stringify(b));assert.ok(b.w>=26&&b.h>=26,label+' small target: '+JSON.stringify(b))}return boxes}
async function clearStatusLayout(page,label){const overlaps=await page.evaluate(()=>{const ids=['hud','god-badge','toast'],boxes=ids.map(id=>{const e=document.getElementById(id);if(!e||!e.getClientRects().length||(id==='toast'&&!e.classList.contains('show')))return null;const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return {id,x:r.x,y:r.y,right:r.right,bottom:r.bottom}}).filter(Boolean),bad=[];for(let i=0;i<boxes.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<boxes.length;j++){const a=boxes[i],b=boxes[j];if(Math.min(a.right,b.right)-Math.max(a.x,b.x)>1&&Math.min(a.bottom,b.bottom)-Math.max(a.y,b.y)>1)bad.push({a,b})}return bad});ok(overlaps.length===0,label+' status HUD, god badge and toast do not overlap: '+JSON.stringify(overlaps))}
async function pause(page){if(await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().mode)==='playing'){await page.keyboard.press('Escape');await page.waitForFunction(()=>gameInfo().mode==='paused')}}
async function home(page){await pause(page);await page.click('#home');await page.waitForFunction(()=>gameInfo().mode==='menu'&&!gameInfo().camera.fullscreen&&!gameInfo().camera.locked)}
(async()=>{const browser=await chromium.launch({channel:'msedge',headless:true});let current;
try{
 for(const order of [[0,1],[1,0]]){const {context,page}=await contextPage(browser);current=page;
  ok(await page.locator('[data-level="2"]').getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='true','Fresh third 3D level locked ('+order+')');
  for(const level of [0,1]){await page.click(`[data-level="${level}"]`);assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().level),level)}ok(true,'Both original 3D levels remain freely selectable ('+order+')');
  const selected=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().level);await page.locator('[data-level="2"]').evaluate(e=>e.click());assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().level),selected);
  ok(await page.evaluate(()=>__qa.setSelected(2))===false,'Direct selection rejects locked third level ('+order+')');
  ok(await page.evaluate(()=>__qa.begin(2))===false,'Actual begin rejects locked third level ('+order+')');
  await page.click('#god-menu');await godSynced(page,true);ok(await page.evaluate(()=>__qa.begin(2))===false,'God mode cannot bypass 3D unlock ('+order+')');await page.keyboard.press('KeyG');await godSynced(page,false);
  await stagedComplete(page,order[0]);ok(await page.locator('[data-level="2"]').getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='true','One prior completion keeps third locked ('+order+')');
  await stagedComplete(page,order[1]);ok(await page.locator('[data-level="2"]').getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='false','Two prior completions immediately unlock third ('+order+')');
  assert.deepEqual(await page.evaluate(key=>JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)).completed,progressKey),[true,true,false]);
  await page.reload();await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.__qa&&document.querySelector('#loading').classList.contains('hidden'));ok(await page.locator('[data-level="2"]').getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='false','3D completion unlock persists after reload ('+order+')');
  await page.click('[data-level="2"]');await page.click('#start');assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().level),2);assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().checkpointCount),1);ok(await page.evaluate(()=>{const w=__qa.world();return (!w.enemies||w.enemies.length===0)&&typeof w.attack!=='function'&&w.def.checkpoints.length===0&&w.platforms.length>30}),'Third level is a long trap route without enemies or attacks and only start checkpoint ('+order+')');await context.close();
 }
 for(const [legacy,unlocked] of [[{'mosslight-best-0':'62.4','mosslight-best-1':'95'},true],[{'mosslight-best-0':'62.4'},false],[{'mosslight-best-0':'0','mosslight-best-1':'95'},false],[{'mosslight-best-0':'Infinity','mosslight-best-1':'95'},false],[{'mosslight-pixel-progress':{version:1,completed:[true,true,true]},'mosslight-pixel-best':{0:620,1:940}},false]]){const {context,page}=await contextPage(browser,legacy);current=page;ok((await page.locator('[data-level="2"]').getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='false')===unlocked,'Legacy / independent-save gate '+JSON.stringify(legacy));await context.close()}
 const unlocked={[progressKey]:{version:1,completed:[true,true,false]}};
 {const {context,page}=await contextPage(browser,unlocked);current=page;
  const link=page.locator('#to-2d');assert.equal((await link.textContent()).trim(),'前往2D');const target=await link.getAttribute('href');assert.equal(new URL(target,page.url()).pathname,new URL('2d/',page.url()).pathname);await link.click();await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.pixelInfo&&pixelInfo().loaded);const returnLink=page.getByRole('link',{name:'前往3D',exact:true});assert.equal(await returnLink.count(),1);const back=await returnLink.getAttribute('href');assert.equal(new URL(back,page.url()).pathname,new URL('../',page.url()).pathname);ok(true,'Exact 前往2D / 前往3D links lead between correct routes');await context.close()}
 {const {context,page}=await contextPage(browser,unlocked);current=page;
  await page.click('[data-level="2"]');await page.click('#god-hud');await godSynced(page,true);await page.click('#god-menu');await godSynced(page,false);ok(true,'Header and main-menu god toggles synchronize');
  await page.click('#start');await page.waitForFunction(()=>gameInfo().camera.locked&&gameInfo().camera.fullscreen);await pause(page);
  await page.evaluate(()=>{const w=__qa.world();w.collected.add(0)});
  const stable=()=>page.evaluate(()=>{const w=__qa.world();return {level:w.level,time:w.time,position:{x:w.player.x,y:w.player.y,z:w.player.z},collected:[...w.collected],checkpoint:w.checkpoint,deaths:w.deaths,farthest:w.farthest}});
  const before=await stable();await page.click('#god-pause');await godSynced(page,true);assert.deepEqual(await stable(),before);await page.keyboard.press('KeyG');await godSynced(page,false);assert.deepEqual(await stable(),before);ok(true,'Pause button and G preserve time, position, collection and level progress');
  await page.click('#god-pause');await page.click('#modal-primary');await page.waitForFunction(()=>gameInfo().mode==='playing');
  const y=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player.y);await page.keyboard.down('Space');await page.waitForTimeout(240);await page.keyboard.up('Space');const raised=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player.y);ok(raised>y+1,'God Space ascends');await page.waitForTimeout(350);const hovered=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player.y);await page.waitForTimeout(250);ok(Math.abs((await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player.y))-hovered)<.05,'God flight hovers without gravity');
  for(const key of ['ShiftLeft','ShiftRight']){const from=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player.y);await page.keyboard.down(key);await page.waitForTimeout(130);await page.keyboard.up(key);ok((await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player.y))<from-.5,'God '+key+' descends')}
  const pos=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player);await page.keyboard.down('KeyD');await page.waitForTimeout(170);await page.keyboard.up('KeyD');await page.keyboard.down('KeyW');await page.waitForTimeout(170);await page.keyboard.up('KeyW');const moved=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player);ok(moved.x>pos.x+.5&&moved.z<pos.z-.5,'God WASD moves horizontally');
  const rotation=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().playerVisualRotation);if(rotation){const [x,,z]=Array.isArray(rotation)?rotation:[rotation.x,rotation.y,rotation.z];ok(Math.abs(x)<.001&&Math.abs(z)<.001,'Cube remains upright during flight')}
  await pause(page);await page.evaluate(()=>{const w=__qa.world(),a=w.platforms.find(a=>a.kind==='laser');w.time=w.attemptTime=a.period*.8-(a.offset||0);w.respawnGrace=0;Object.assign(w.player,{x:a.x,y:a.y,z:a.z,vx:0,vy:0,vz:0,grounded:true,on:a.id})});const deaths=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().deaths);await page.click('#modal-primary');await page.waitForTimeout(230);ok(await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().deaths)===deaths,'God flight survives active laser contact');
  await pause(page);await page.evaluate(()=>{const w=__qa.world();Object.assign(w.player,{x:50,y:-20,z:0,vx:0,vy:0,vz:0,grounded:false,on:null});w.respawnGrace=0});await page.click('#modal-primary');await page.waitForTimeout(160);ok(await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().deaths)===deaths&&await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player.y)<0,'God mode prevents abyss respawn');
  await pause(page);await page.evaluate(()=>{const w=__qa.world();Object.assign(w.player,{x:0,y:5,z:1,vx:0,vy:0,vz:0,grounded:false,on:null})});await page.click('#god-pause');await godSynced(page,false);await page.click('#modal-primary');const fall=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player.y);await page.waitForTimeout(260);ok(await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player.y)<fall-.4,'Disabling god mode restores gravity');
  await pause(page);await page.evaluate(()=>{const w=__qa.world(),a=w.platforms.find(a=>a.kind==='laser');w.time=w.attemptTime=a.period*.8-(a.offset||0);w.respawnGrace=0;Object.assign(w.player,{x:a.x,y:a.y,z:a.z,vx:0,vy:0,vz:0,grounded:true,on:a.id})});await page.click('#modal-primary');await page.waitForFunction(n=>gameInfo().deaths>n,deaths);ok(await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().checkpoint===0&&gameInfo().player.on===0),'Normal trap damage returns player to sole start checkpoint');
  await pause(page);await page.click('#god-pause');await page.reload();await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.__qa&&document.querySelector('#loading').classList.contains('hidden'));await godSynced(page,true);ok(true,'God preference persists with all three buttons synchronized');await context.close();
 }
 {const {context,page}=await contextPage(browser);current=page;await page.click('#start');await page.waitForFunction(()=>gameInfo().camera.locked&&gameInfo().camera.fullscreen);await page.waitForTimeout(300);const initial=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo());
  await page.mouse.move(720,450);await page.mouse.move(920,150,{steps:20});await page.waitForTimeout(350);const up=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo());ok(Math.abs(up.camera.yaw-initial.camera.yaw)>.3&&up.camera.pitch<0&&up.camera.forward[1]>0,'Fullscreen locked mouse rotates yaw and looks upward');await page.screenshot({path:path.join(out,'mouse-look-up.png')});
  await page.mouse.move(920,760,{steps:20});await page.waitForTimeout(350);const down=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo());ok(down.camera.pitch>.4&&down.camera.forward[1]<-.5,'Locked mouse looks downward');await page.screenshot({path:path.join(out,'mouse-look-down.png')});
  await page.keyboard.press('KeyC');await page.waitForTimeout(400);ok(Math.abs(await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().camera.pitch)-.5)<.01,'C resets camera pitch');await pause(page);ok(await page.evaluate(()=>!gameInfo().camera.locked),'Escape pauses and releases pointer lock');const time=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().time);await page.waitForTimeout(200);assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().time),time);await page.click('#modal-primary');await page.waitForFunction(()=>gameInfo().mode==='playing'&&gameInfo().camera.locked&&gameInfo().camera.fullscreen);ok(true,'Resume restores fullscreen and pointer lock');await page.evaluate(()=>document.exitPointerLock());await page.waitForFunction(()=>gameInfo().mode==='paused');ok(true,'External pointer-lock loss pauses');await home(page);ok(true,'Home exits fullscreen and pointer lock');await context.close();
 }
 for(const [width,height] of [[1440,900],[390,844],[360,640],[844,390]]){const mobile=width!==1440,{context,page}=await contextPage(browser,unlocked,{viewport:{width,height},isMobile:mobile,hasTouch:mobile});current=page;const name=`${width}x${height}`;await page.click('[data-level="2"]');await page.waitForTimeout(200);
  const menu=await fits(page,'[data-level],#god-menu,#start,#god-hud,#sound,#fullscreen,#to-2d',name+' menu');assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth),false);await page.screenshot({path:path.join(out,name+'-menu.png')});
  await page.click('#start');await page.waitForTimeout(220);await page.screenshot({path:path.join(out,name+'-game.png')});await page.keyboard.press('KeyG');await godSynced(page,true);const game=await fits(page,mobile?'#god-hud,#pause,#jump,#down,#joystick':'#god-hud,#pause',name+' god game');await clearStatusLayout(page,name);await page.screenshot({path:path.join(out,name+'-god-game.png')});
  if(mobile){const y=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player.y);const up=await page.locator('#jump').boundingBox();await page.mouse.move(up.x+up.width/2,up.y+up.height/2);await page.mouse.down();await page.waitForTimeout(210);await page.mouse.up();ok((await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player.y))>y+.7,name+' touch up button flies upward');const raised=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player.y),down=await page.locator('#down').boundingBox();await page.mouse.move(down.x+down.width/2,down.y+down.height/2);await page.mouse.down();await page.waitForTimeout(180);await page.mouse.up();ok((await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().player.y))<raised-.6,name+' touch down button descends');await page.click('#god-hud');await godSynced(page,false);await page.click('#god-hud');await godSynced(page,true);ok(true,name+' header toggle is physically clickable');
   const camera=await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().camera.yaw),cdp=await context.newCDPSession(page),x=width*.58,yDrag=height*.48;await cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent',{type:'touchStart',touchPoints:[{x,y:yDrag,id:1}]});await cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent',{type:'touchMove',touchPoints:[{x:Math.min(width-15,x+85),y:yDrag+25,id:1}]});await cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent',{type:'touchEnd',touchPoints:[]});await page.waitForTimeout(250);ok(Math.abs((await page.evaluate(()=>gameInfo().camera.yaw))-camera)>.2,name+' touch drag rotates camera');await page.click('#pause');
  }else await pause(page);
  const paused=await fits(page,'#god-pause,#modal-primary,#restart,#home',name+' pause');await page.screenshot({path:path.join(out,name+'-pause.png')});report.layouts.push({width,height,menu,game,pause:paused});await context.close();
 }
 assert.deepEqual(report.errors,[]);report.passed=true;fs.rmSync(path.join(out,'failure.png'),{force:true});fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out,'results.json'),JSON.stringify(report,null,2));console.log(JSON.stringify({passed:true,checks:report.checks.length,layouts:report.layouts.length,errors:report.errors,artifacts:out}));
}catch(error){report.passed=false;report.failure=String(error.stack||error);if(current&&!current.isClosed())await current.screenshot({path:path.join(out,'failure.png')}).catch(()=>{});fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out,'results.json'),JSON.stringify(report,null,2));throw error}finally{await browser.close()}
})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1});
